h1: SweetLoft Hotel Don Muang — the budget option near Don Mueang Airport, 6 km from the terminal
intro: If you have an early flight out of Don Mueang and want a proper bed nearby without spending more than you need to, SweetLoft Hotel Don Muang makes a solid case — a 3-star property on Soi Song Prapha 30 in the Don Mueang district, around 6 km from the terminal. A taxi takes roughly 12 minutes and costs about 59 THB; cabs are easy to flag outside the hotel at any hour. It has 58 rooms, a Thai restaurant, buffet breakfast, free parking and free Wi-Fi. Rates start from around ฿650/night in low season and climb to around ฿1,200 at peak times. The hotel scores 8.4 from 252 real guest reviews on Trip.com — the honest caveat is that beds are firm, walls are thin and cleanliness can be inconsistent, as real-guest feedback across platforms makes clear.

body.html: The main draw is a simple one: SweetLoft sits closer to Don Mueang Airport than almost anything at this price. The hotel occupies a plot on Soi Song Prapha 30 in Si Kan sub-district — around 6 km from Don Mueang International Airport (DMK), the hub for Air Asia, Nok Air and other low-cost carriers. A standard taxi covers the distance in about 12 minutes for roughly 59 THB at the meter; cabs queue outside the hotel day and night. Don Mueang railway station is about 3.5 km away by road, and shared songthaew vans run along Song Prapha Road if you want public transport. The surrounding street is lively with local restaurants, markets, 7-Eleven and a Tops Supermarket within walking distance.

For a 3-star hotel at budget rates, the facilities are more comprehensive than you might expect. The property has a Thai restaurant serving three meals, a buffet breakfast (included in some room rates or available at around 100 THB per person), free parking, free Wi-Fi in public areas, a 24-hour front desk, an on-site convenience store, ATM, laundry, hair salon, business centre and conference room. The 58 rooms include Superior Doubles (18 sqm), Deluxe Queens (23 sqm), Suites and Family Rooms. All rooms have private air-conditioning, a flat-screen TV and en-suite bathrooms. There is no swimming pool.

Across multiple platforms the most consistent praise is for the location and the convenience of being a short, cheap taxi ride from the departure terminal. Guests who need to park a car and fly also rate it well — free parking with 24-hour access makes it practical for road-trippers connecting through DMK. Staff are generally described as friendly; the restaurant gets decent marks for local Thai food. Several reviewers note that having a Tops Supermarket and a row of street food stalls within a five-minute walk makes it easy to stock up before an early flight or decompress after landing.
"Great location for the airport — cheap taxi, only about 10–12 minutes. Staff were helpful. Clean enough for a one-night transit stop. Food on the street outside is the best part."

Where the property struggles — and this is consistent across Booking.com, TripAdvisor and KAYAK — is bed comfort and room quality. Hard mattresses come up in a disproportionate number of reviews, as do thin walls that let in noise from neighbouring rooms, loud air-conditioning units in older rooms, and bathroom maintenance issues including leaking pipes and occasional mould. Booking.com's cleanliness subscore sits at 6.9; KAYAK's bed comfort score is notably low. These are not one-off complaints — they reflect the building's age and the maintenance budget that comes with budget-tier pricing. Rooms were also described as darker than photos suggest in some cases.

One important distinction to be clear about: this hotel does not offer an airport shuttle. Unlike Amari Don Muang, which connects to the terminal via a covered skywalk, SweetLoft requires you to take a taxi each way. At roughly 59–80 THB per trip that is genuinely minimal, but it is worth factoring in if you have a pre-dawn flight, heavy luggage or are travelling with children. The hotel can help arrange a taxi on request. Also note: Don Mueang and Suvarnabhumi are 30+ km apart — this hotel is not suited for Suvarnabhumi connections.

On balance, SweetLoft Hotel Don Muang scores 8.4 out of 10 on Trip.com from 252 verified reviews — a respectable result for the price bracket. It is most sensibly chosen by budget travellers on low-cost carriers out of DMK who need a clean place to sleep for one or two nights and can accept firm mattresses and thin walls as the trade-off for saving money. Rates run from around ฿650/night for a Superior Double in low season to around ฿1,200 at peak periods for the same room type. Book in advance when there are concerts or events at IMPACT Arena Muang Thong Thani (8 km away), as local demand can lift prices sharply.

honestSummary: SweetLoft Hotel Don Muang is the cheapest practical base near Don Mueang Airport that still gives you air-conditioning, a restaurant and free parking — the trade-off is firm beds, thin walls and cleanliness that real guest reviews describe as hit-or-miss across the property.
honestChecks: If you are a light sleeper or sensitive to noise — walls between rooms are thin and some AC units are loud. Guest noise from neighbouring rooms comes up regularly across reviews → bring earplugs or request a room on an upper floor away from neighbouring guests.

If you need an airport shuttle — the hotel offers no transfers; you must take a metered taxi (approx. 59–80 THB, ~12 minutes). If you need door-to-door convenience pre-dawn, Amari Don Muang has a covered skywalk to the terminal, though at a considerably higher room rate.

If cleanliness and bed comfort are priorities — multiple platforms flag firm mattresses, occasional mould patches and plumbing niggles in older rooms. If those are deal-breakers, budget slightly more for a mid-range option in the same neighbourhood.

tips.title: Taxis are available 24 hours
tips.body: No hotel shuttle, but metered taxis queue outside around the clock. The airport run costs roughly 59–80 THB and takes about 12 minutes — have small change or a card ready.

tips.title: Song Prapha Road has great street food
tips.body: Local Thai restaurants, a fresh market, 7-Eleven and a Tops Supermarket are all within a short walk. Far better and cheaper than relying solely on the hotel restaurant.

tips.title: Park your car and fly
tips.body: Free on-site parking makes this a useful base for drivers heading out from DMK — park, sleep, taxi to the terminal, collect the car on return. Confirm space availability at check-in if arriving late.

tips.title: Pack earplugs if you sleep lightly
tips.body: Partition walls are thin and AC units can be noisy. Requesting a room on a higher floor or at the end of a corridor reduces the chance of disturbance before a morning flight.

faqTitle: SweetLoft Hotel Don Muang — Frequently Asked Questions

faq.q: Where is SweetLoft Hotel Don Muang and how far is it from Don Mueang Airport?
faq.a: The hotel is at 40 Soi Song Prapha 30, Si Kan, Don Mueang, Bangkok 10210. It is approximately 6 km from Don Mueang International Airport (DMK) — a metered taxi takes around 12 minutes and costs roughly 59–80 THB. Taxis are available outside the hotel 24 hours a day.

faq.q: Does SweetLoft Hotel Don Muang offer an airport shuttle?
faq.a: No — the hotel does not operate an airport shuttle service. Guests must take a metered taxi to Don Mueang Airport (approx. 59–80 THB, ~12 minutes). Cabs are readily available outside the hotel at all hours. If you need a hotel with a direct connection, Amari Don Muang has a covered skywalk to the terminal, but at a significantly higher room rate.

faq.q: How much does SweetLoft Hotel Don Muang cost per night?
faq.a: Rates start from around ฿650/night for a Superior Double in low season. Deluxe Queen rooms run from around ฿750; Suites from ฿1,100 and Family Rooms from ฿1,300. Prices climb to roughly ฿1,000–฿1,300 during peak season or when events are held at nearby IMPACT Arena Muang Thong Thani. Always compare platforms before booking.

faq.q: Is there free parking at SweetLoft Hotel Don Muang?
faq.a: Yes — on-site parking is free, which makes the hotel particularly useful for travellers who drive to Bangkok, park overnight and fly out of Don Mueang the following morning. Confirm availability at check-in, especially for late arrivals or extended stays.

faq.q: Who is SweetLoft Hotel Don Muang best suited for?
faq.a: It is best suited for budget travellers flying low-cost carriers from Don Mueang Airport who need a practical, affordable place to sleep before or after a flight. Also well-suited for drivers who want to park and fly. It is less suitable for travellers who prioritise soft beds, sound insulation or a hotel shuttle — or anyone flying from Suvarnabhumi Airport (BKK), which is more than 30 km away.
